originals.why: Natural, and it echoes the seed's 'medra i brynu'.

originals.ko: 그는 엽서 몇 장을 원하지 않아
originals.why: Grammatical with the same sense. 원하지 않아 is used because ~고 싶어하지 않아 cannot take a noun object directly.

originals.ko: 나는 엽서 몇 장을 원하지 않아
originals.why: Grammatical, and it is the negative of o4.
A natural noun-phrase fragment. The LEGO has the same sense.

originals.ko: 나는 다음번에 엽서 몇 장을 살 수 있어
originals.why: Natural. 'tro nesa'' sits naturally at the end of the clause.

originals.ko: 그녀는 엽서 몇 장 사는 걸 잊어버렸어
originals.why: Natural. The soft mutation after anghofio (brynu) is correct.

originals.ko: 나는 그녀에게 엽서 몇 장을 사 달라고 요청할 거야
originals.why: Natural: 'gofyn iddi' followed by a mutated verb-noun. 요청하다 is used because 부탁해 is already the gloss for 'os gwelwch yn dda'.
A natural fragment. 'y fynedfa' mutates correctly.
